summary: The positive-load derivations are otherwise supported by the supplied predecessor facts, but the candidate states its endpoint-rank conclusions for every nonzero charge even though an allowed nonzero charge can have zero fresh load. In that case the displayed affine-rank quantities are not defined, and the proof does not cover the case.
critical_errors: Equations (19)-(24) are stated without assuming \(\widehat\Omega>0\), although \(\widehat\rho_\beta=\dim\operatorname{aff}(E_\beta)\), \(\widehat r_\beta\), and hence \(\widehat L_\beta\) are not defined by the supplied facts when \(E_\beta=\varnothing\). This is an actual allowed case, not a remote degeneracy: the hard ledger and the original load inequality ensure some original edge has \(\omega_e>0\), one may choose a nonzero \(\beta\) supported only on that edge, and the candidate's own equation (28) then gives \(\widehat\Omega=0\) and \(E_\beta=\varnothing\). Thus (22)-(24), especially (23), contain undefined terms for a charge covered by the statement.
gaps: The proof explicitly begins the endpoint-selector argument with 'Suppose \(\widehat\Omega>0\)' and derives (16)-(24) only under that supposition, but the corresponding conclusions in the statement are not scoped by it and no separate zero-load argument or convention is supplied. Accepted fact 6e66cd69e25232b7 itself also assumes positive load.
repair_hints: Add an explicit \(\widehat\Omega>0\) hypothesis before defining the endpoint affine ranks and scope (22)-(24), including (23), under it. If an unconditional retention-selector conclusion is desired, state the zero-load case separately: \(\widehat\Omega=0\) and (11) imply \(R_C(\beta)=B\), so (8) gives \(R\ge B\). Alternatively, define and justify explicit empty-support conventions and reprove every affected display under those conventions.
